value.summary: The brief lists six desired capabilities: authentication, production listing, selling, cash paycheck, product recommendations using machine learning, and an admin page. It provides no workflows, platform, integrations, or detailed acceptance criteria.

requirements.text: Use machine learning to recommend products to customers.

ambiguities: “Production listing” could mean a list of products, production runs, or another kind of production record.
“Selling page” does not specify whether it is a product catalog, checkout flow, point-of-sale interface, or sales-recording page.
“Cash paycheck page” is unclear; it could refer to cash payroll, issuing paychecks, or recording cash payments.
The authentication methods, user roles, and access rules are unspecified.
The machine-learning recommendation inputs, placement, expected behavior, and quality criteria are unspecified.
The admin page's management functions and permissions are unspecified.
assumptions: Each listed item represents a desired user-facing page or capability, not a fully specified workflow.
The product recommendation capability is intended for customers, as stated, but its delivery channel is not specified.
risks: The brief is too high-level to estimate implementation reliably; page names may conceal substantial workflows and business rules.
The recommendation feature may require suitable historical data, consent, and ongoing model evaluation, none of which are described.
Authentication and admin functionality may require security, privacy, and audit controls that are not specified.
The meaning of “cash paycheck” could materially change the domain model and integrations required.

unknowns.question: Does “cash paycheck” mean payroll processing or issuing paychecks to employees?
unknowns.why_it_matters: A payroll or paycheck workflow may require employee records, calculations, approvals, payment integrations, and compliance handling beyond a simple page.

scenario_if_yes.title: Implement payroll or paycheck workflow and calculations

unknowns.question: Does the product recommendation feature require training a custom model using existing customer and sales data?
unknowns.why_it_matters: Custom recommendations can require data discovery, preparation, model development, evaluation, and deployment; a simple rules-based or third-party solution would have a different effort profile.

scenario_if_yes.title: Integrate model inference into the application

unknowns.question: Does authentication need to support external identity providers, multi-factor authentication, or role-based access control?
unknowns.why_it_matters: These capabilities add identity integrations, authorization design, and additional security and testing work beyond basic sign-in.

scenario_if_yes.title: Implement advanced authentication and access control
Configure identity provider and security deployment

unknowns.question: Does the selling page need to accept online payments?
unknowns.why_it_matters: Payment acceptance requires a payment provider integration, transaction handling, and payment-specific testing and security considerations.

scenario_if_yes.title: Integrate payment provider and transaction handling
Implement checkout and payment user interface
Test payment flows and failure cases
